dsh-drawio 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。AI 驱动 drawio：四个画图工具（校验 / 渲染 SVG/PNG / 编辑 / 模板）+ 侧栏实时画板——零依赖 mxfile→SVG 预览、内嵌 diagrams.net 官方编辑器、AI 画图时自动弹出跟随。

posts.en:
dsh-drawio is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. AI-driven drawio: four agent tools (validate, render to SVG/PNG, edit, template) plus a sidebar live board — zero-dependency mxfile-to-SVG preview, embedded diagrams.net editor with save bridge, and auto-open whenever the agent draws.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-2b55396a29e751d27712.html
